decisions.note: Round-1 default and round-2 delivery both auto-fetch only title+favicon, omitting the description and preview image REF-BM-02 requires; client affirmed both times without asking for the missing fields.

Delivered search is plain SQL LIKE over title/url/notes (no description field, no #tag syntax, no AND/OR/NOT/parentheses, no quoted-phrase exact match); maker self-flagged FTS5 as the 'upgrade path' but client affirmed as 'everything I asked for'.
Import/export was built as JSON instead of the Netscape HTML format the reference specifies; client's blanket approval did not catch the format mismatch.
